serviceDescription: Compass FedRAMP Advisory Group helps Cloud Service Providers navigate FedRAMP 20x certification, from initial readiness assessment through Key Security Indicator implementation and Trust Center publication. We specialize in guiding SaaS providers new to the federal market through their first certification.

servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Gap analysis against applicable FedRAMP Requirements and Key Security Indicators, with a prioritized remediation roadmap.
Hands-on support authoring the Certification Package Overview and Security Decision Record, including KSI implementation, validation, and assessment statements.
Guidance on standing up a self-service Trust Center meeting the CDS-TRC rule family requirements for programmatic and human-readable access.

customerReferences: "Compass helped us go from zero FedRAMP experience to a published Certification Package Overview in under four months." — VP of Engineering, mid-size SaaS provider
